why: The over-correction, and the reason the teleport is read per tank rather than raised into the world-level `snap` beside `roundStartTick`: snapping unconditionally freezes every tank in the arena onto its current-tick pose, so nothing in the game interpolates at all and motion becomes a 60 Hz stutter. It is invisible to any test that renders a single alpha or a single tank, which is what `snaps only the revived tank: the other player keeps interpolating on the same sync` exists for -- and `interpolates normally within a round` catches the same thing from the pre-#239 side of the file.
